paragraphs: We are a global provider of Artificial Intelligence-of-Things ("AIoT") solutions providing valuable connected business intelligence for managing high-value enterprise and mid-market assets that improve operational efficiencies.
We are headquartered in Woodcliff Lake, New Jersey, with offices located around the globe.

Our Unity data highway and AIoT ecosystem is the centerpiece of our strategy. Unity has the capability to ingest data from multiple data sources, harmonizing and transforming the dataset, and delivering simply understood actionable insights through a unified Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") platform and deep integrations with customer business systems.
Unity provides mission-critical solutions from warehouse to trailer to vehicle, allowing customers to consolidate suppliers and gain end-to-end control of their operations in a single pane of glass.

Unity enables customers to consume their data in multiple ways, from data-powered applications to unified operations integrations, which provide the ability to improve performance of the asset, the individual in charge of the asset, and the business process, continuously improving our customers' business performance.

Within the Unity ecosystem, our Powerfleet for Warehouse, Yard and Site AIoT solutions are designed to provide on-premise or in-facility asset safety, compliance and operator management, monitoring, and visibility for warehouse and factory trucks such as forklifts, man-lifts, tuggers and ground support equipment at airports. These solutions utilize a variety of communications capabilities such as Bluetooth®, WiFi, and proprietary radio frequency technology, as well as artificial intelligence ("AI") video solutions for pedestrian proximity detection and incident prevention.

Additionally, within the Unity ecosystem, our Powerfleet for On-Road AIoT and AI video solutions are designed to provide bumper-to-bumper AIoT asset management, monitoring, and visibility for over-the-road based assets such as heavy trucks, dry-van trailers, refrigerated trailers and shipping containers and their associated cargo. These AIoT solutions provide mobile-asset tracking and condition-monitoring solutions to meet the transportation market's desire for greater visibility, safety, security, and productivity throughout global supply chains. Our On-Road AIoT solutions extend to all mobile assets, whether it is a rental car, a private fleet, or automotive original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") partners. We achieve this by providing critical information that can be used to increase revenues, reduce costs, enhance safety and sustainability, deliver compliance, and improve customer service.

Our patented technologies are proven solutions for organizations that must monitor and analyze their assets to improve safety, increase efficiency, reduce costs, and drive profitability. Our offerings are sold under the global brands Powerfleet, Pointer, Cellocator, MiX by Powerfleet and Fleet Complete.

We have an established history of Internet-of-Things ("IoT") device development, AI and data science expertise, and innovation creating devices that can withstand harsh and rugged environments. With 35 patents and patent applications and over 30 years' experience, we believe we are well-positioned to evolve our offerings for even greater value to customers through our cloud-based applications for unified operations.

We deliver advanced data solutions that connect mobile assets to increase visibility, operational efficiency and profitability. Across our spectrum of vertical markets, we differentiate ourselves through our end-to-end Unity solutions that collect data from unique sensors. Because we are data source and OEM agnostic, we help organizations view and manage their mixed assets homogeneously. All of our solutions are paired with SaaS and analytics tools to provide an even deeper level of insights and understanding of how assets are utilized and how drivers and operators operate those assets. These insights include a full set of key performance indicators to drive operational and strategic decisions. Our customers typically get a return on their investment in less than 12 months from deployment.

Our enterprise software applications have AI and machine learning capabilities and are built to integrate with our customers' management systems to provide a single, integrated view of asset and operator activity across multiple locations while providing real-time enterprise-wide benchmarks and peer-industry comparisons. We look for analytics, as well as the data contained therein, to differentiate us from our competitors, adding significant value to customers' business operations, and helping to contribute to their bottom line. Our solutions also feature open application programming interfaces ("APIs") for additional integrations and development to boost other enterprise management systems and third-party applications.

We market and sell our Unity ecosystem and our connected AIoT data solutions to a wide range of customers in the commercial and government sectors. Our customers operate in diverse markets, such as manufacturing, automotive manufacturing, wholesale and retail, food and grocery distribution, pharmaceutical and medical distribution, construction, mining, utilities, aerospace, vehicle rental, as well as logistics, shipping, transportation, energy and field services. Traditionally, these businesses have relied on multiple vendors, as well as manual, often paper-based, processes or on-premise legacy software to operate their high-value assets, manage workforce resources, and distributed sites; and face environmental, safety, and other regulatory requirements. In today's landscape, it is crucial for these businesses to invest in solutions that enable easy analysis and sharing of real-time information, increasingly consolidating their suppliers.

On April 2, 2024, we consummated the transactions contemplated by the Implementation Agreement, dated as of October 10, 2023 (the "Implementation Agreement"), that we entered into with Main Street 2000 Proprietary Limited, a private company incorporated in the Republic of South Africa and our wholly owned subsidiary ("Powerfleet Sub"), and MiX Telematics Limited, formerly a public company incorporated under the laws of the Republic of South Africa ("MiX Telematics"), pursuant to which, Powerfleet Sub acquired all the issued ordinary shares of MiX Telematics (including those represented by MiX Telematics' American Depositary Shares) through the implementation of a scheme of arrangement (the "Scheme") in accordance with Sections 114 and 115 of the South African Companies Act, No. 71 of 2008, as amended (the "Companies Act"), in exchange for shares of our common stock. As a result, MiX Telematics became our indirect, wholly owned subsidiary (the "MiX Combination"). Since the closing of the MiX Combination, we have made significant progress in integrating the MiX Telematics business into our operations, with alignment of core functions and early realization of operational synergies.

On October 1, 2024, we consummated the transactions contemplated by the Share Purchase Agreement, dated as of September 18, 2024 (the "Purchase Agreement"), by and among Golden Eagle Topco, LP ("Golden Eagle LP"), the persons that are party to the Purchase Agreement under the heading "Other Sellers" (the "Other Sellers" and, together with Golden Eagle LP, the "Sellers"), the Company and Powerfleet Canada Holdings Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the "Canadian SPV" and, together with the Company, the "Purchasers"), pursuant to which the Purchasers acquired all of the direct and indirect common shares in the capital of Golden Eagle Canada Holdings, Inc. ("Canada Holdco") and Complete Innovations Holdings Inc. ("CIH"), and all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Golden Eagle Holdings, Inc. (together with Canada Holdco and CIH, "Fleet Complete"). As a result, Fleet Complete became an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the "FC Acquisition").

headings: We have incurred significant losses and have a substantial accumulated deficit. If we cannot achieve profitability, the market price of our common stock could decline significantly.
As an international company, we are exposed to macroeconomic, geopolitical, trade, sanctions and regulatory risks that could materially and adversely affect our business and financial results.
We are subject to breaches of our information technology systems, which could damage our reputation, vendor, and customer relationships, and our customers' access to our services.

The industry in which we operate is highly competitive, and competitive pressures from existing and new companies could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.
Failure to correctly and efficiently implement ERP and customer relationship management ("CRM") systems could have a material and adverse effect on our business.
The international scope of our business exposes us to risks associated with foreign exchange rates, currency fluctuations and economic instability in certain emerging markets.
We may need to obtain additional capital to fund our operations that could have negative consequences on our business.
Our revenue may be adversely affected if we lose one or more significant customers or if such customers reduce or delay purchases.
Failure to adequately protect our intellectual property rights or defend against third-party claims could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Our Israeli subsidiaries have incurred significant indebtedness.
The terms of the A&R Credit Agreement restrict Powerfleet Israel's and Pointer's current and future operations, particularly their ability to respond to changes or to take certain actions.
Goodwill impairment or intangible impairment charges may affect our results of operations in the future.
Failure to maintain effective internal control over financial reporting could adversely affect our business and investor confidence.
The use of our products is subject to international regulations.
The adoption of industry standards that do not incorporate the technology we use may decrease or eliminate the demand for our services or products and could harm our results of operations.
paragraphs: In addition to the other information contained in this Form 10-K, the following risk factors should be considered carefully in evaluating the Company and our business. The risks described below could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to the Company or that the Company currently deems immaterial may also adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. The summary below is not exhaustive, and investors should read this "Risk Factors" section in full. These and other risks are described in more detail in this Item 1A. Risk Factors.

Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including those described under the section titled "Risk Factors" immediately following this summary. These risks include, among others, the following:

•We may not fully realize the anticipated benefits of our acquisitions and ongoing business transformation initiatives, and these integration and business transformation initiatives may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations, including our financial reporting and internal control over financial reporting.
•We have incurred significant losses and have a substantial accumulated deficit. If we cannot achieve profitability, the market price of our common stock could decline significantly.
•As an international company, we are exposed to macroeconomic, geopolitical, trade, sanctions and regulatory risks that could materially and adversely affect our business and financial results.

•Disruptions in our global supply chain, performance issues with subcontractors, or our reliance on a limited number of suppliers for critical components may materially and adversely affect our ability to manufacture and deliver products and may reduce our revenues and gross margins.

paragraphs: The following discussion is intended to assist you in understanding our financial condition and results of operations and should be read in conjunction with the financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Many of the amounts and percentages in this section have been rounded for convenience of presentation, but actual recorded amounts have been used in computations. Accordingly, some information may appear not to be computed accurately.

This section of this Form 10-K discusses our financial condition and results of operations for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2026 and 2025 in accordance with GAAP. We have adopted various accounting policies that govern the application of accounting principles generally accepted in the United States in the preparation of our consolidated financial statements. We believe the following accounting policies involve a high degree of judgment and complexity, and our other significant accounting policies are described in Note 2 to our consolidated financial statements included in this Form 10-K. Certain accounting policies involve significant judgments and assumptions by our management that can have a material impact on the carrying value of certain assets and liabilities. The judgments and assumptions used by our management are based on historical experience and other factors that our management believes to be reasonable under the circumstances. Because of the nature of these judgments and assumptions, actual results could differ significantly from these judgments and estimates, which could have a material impact on the carrying values of our assets and liabilities and our results of operations. Our critical accounting estimates, assumptions and judgments that we believe have the most significant impact on our consolidated results are described below.

Goodwill represents costs in excess of fair values assigned to the underlying net assets of acquired businesses. Goodwill and intangible assets deemed to have indefinite lives are not amortized and are tested for impairment on an annual basis and between annual tests whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate that the carrying amount may not be recoverable. Intangible assets other than goodwill are amortized over their useful lives unless the lives are determined to be indefinite. Intangible assets are carried at cost, less accumulated amortization. Intangible assets consist of trademarks and trade names, patents, customer relationships and other intangible assets. Goodwill is tested at the reporting unit level, which is defined as an operating segment or one level below the operating segment. We operate with one operating segment, which is our only reporting unit and segment presented in the consolidated financial statements. We test our goodwill for impairment annually, which is October 1 or when an indicator of impairment exists, by comparing the fair value of the reporting unit to its carrying value.

We test for goodwill impairment at the reporting unit level on October 1 of each year and between annual tests if a triggering event indicates the possibility of an impairment. As of October 1, 2025, we performed a quantitative assessment whereby the fair value of the reporting unit is calculated using a market approach. The fair value of the reporting unit was substantially more than its carrying value.

paragraphs: 本公司為全球性的人工智慧物聯網（"AIoT"）解決方案供應商，提供具價值的連線商業智慧，用以管理高價值企業與中型市場資產，以提升作業效率。
本公司總部設於新澤西州伍德克里夫湖，並在全球多處設有辦事處。
我們的 Unity 數據高速公路與 AIoT 生態系統為我們策略的核心。Unity 具備從多個數據來源接收數據的能力，並能對數據集進行協調與轉換，透過統一的軟體即服務（"SaaS"）平台與深度整合客戶業務系統，提供簡潔易懂的行動見解。
Unity 提供從倉庫至拖車至車輛的關鍵任務解決方案，使客戶能整合供應商，並在單一畫面中取得其作業的端到端控制。
Unity 使客戶能以多種方式使用其數據，從數據驅動的應用程式到統一作業整合，提供改善資產、資產負責人與業務流程的表現能力，持續提升客戶的業務表現。

在 Unity 生態系統內，我們的 Powerfleet for Warehouse, Yard and Site AIoT 解決方案設計用以提供本地或場內資產的安全、合規與操作管理、監測與可視化，適用於倉庫與工廠的卡車，例如叉車、人字梯、拖車與機場地面支援設備。這些解決方案使用多種通訊能力，如 Bluetooth®、WiFi 以及專用無線電頻率技術，以及人工智慧（"AI"）影片解決方案，用以偵測行人接近與預防事故。

此外，在 Unity 生態系統內，我們的 Powerfleet for On-Road AIoT 與 AI 影片解決方案設計用以提供從車頭至車尾的 AIoT 資產管理、監測與可視化，適用於公路運輸資產，如重型卡車、乾貨拖車、冷藏拖車與貨櫃及其相關貨物。這些 AIoT 解決方案提供移動資產追蹤與狀態監測解決方案，以符合運輸市場對全球供應鏈中更高可視化、安全、安全與生產力的期望。我們的 On-Road AIoT 解決方案適用於所有移動資產，無論是租賃車輛、私人車隊或汽車原廠製造商（"OEM"）夥伴。我們透過提供可用以提高收入、降低成本、增強安全與永續性、達成合規與改善客戶服務的關鍵資訊來實現此目標。
我們的專利技術已被證明為必須監測與分析資產以提高安全、增加效率、降低成本並推動獲利的組織的解決方案。我們的產品與服務以全球品牌 Powerfleet、Pointer、Cellocator、MiX by Powerfleet 及 Fleet Complete 銷售。
本公司擁有長期的物聯網（"IoT"）裝置開發經驗、人工智慧與資料科學專業知識，以及創新能力，能製造出能承受惡劣與嚴苛環境的裝置。擁有35項專利與專利申請，並擁有超過30年的經驗，我們相信本公司已具備優勢，能透過基於雲端的應用程式，為客戶提供更高價值的服務。

我們提供先進的資料解決方案，將移動資產連接起來，提高可見度、營運效率與利潤。在我們涵蓋的各垂直市場中，我們透過端到端的Unity解決方案來區隔自己，該方案能從獨特的感測器收集資料。因為我們不依賴特定資料來源或原廠裝置，我們協助組織以統一的方式觀看與管理其混合資產。我們所有的解決方案均搭配SaaS與分析工具，提供更深入的洞察與理解，以瞭解資產的使用方式以及駕駛員與操作人員如何操作這些資產。這些洞察包含完整的關鍵績效指標，以推動營運與戰略決策。我們的客戶通常在部署後不到12個月內即可獲得投資回報。
我們的企業軟體應用程式具備人工智慧與機器學習功能，並建構為與客戶的管理系統整合，以提供跨多個據點的資產與操作人員活動的統一視圖，同時提供企業範圍內的即時指標與產業對比。我們尋求分析以及其中的資料，以與競爭對手區隔，為客戶的業務運作增加顯著價值，並協助他們提升營運績效。我們的解決方案亦具備開放式應用程式程式設計介面（"APIs"），以進行更多整合與開發，提升其他企業管理系統與第三方應用程式。

我們將Unity生態系統與我們的連線AIoT資料解決方案行銷與銷售給商業與政府部門的廣泛客戶羣。這些客戶經營的市場多樣，例如製造業、汽車製造、批發與零售、食品與雜貨配送、藥品與醫療配送、建設、採礦、電力、航空、車輛租賃，以及物流、運輸、能源與現場服務。這些產業傳統上依賴多個供應商，以及手動、常為紙本的流程或內部架設的舊有軟體來運作其高價值資產、管理人力資源與分散的據點；並面臨環境、安全及其他法規要求。在當前的市場環境中，這些企業必須投資於能輕鬆分析與分享即時資訊的解決方案，並日益整合其供應商。

於2024年4月2日，我們完成根據2023年10月10日簽訂的實施協議（"實施協議"）所預期的交易，該協議為我們與南非共和國註冊的私人公司Main Street 2000 Proprietary Limited（"Main Street 2000"）及我們的 wholly owned subsidiary（"Powerfleet Sub"）以及MiX Telematics Limited（"MiX Telematics"）所簽訂，根據南非公司法第71號2008年法規（"公司法"）第114及115條，透過方案安排（"方案"）進行交易，以換取我們的普通股。因此，MiX Telematics成為我們間接且完全所有的子公司（"MiX組合"）。自MiX組合交易完成後，我們已於整合MiX Telematics業務至我們運作中取得顯著進展，包括核心功能的對齊與運營協同效益的初步實現。

於2024年10月1日，我們完成根據2024年9月18日簽訂的股份買賣協議（"買賣協議"）所預期的交易，該協議由Golden Eagle Topco, LP（"Golden Eagle LP"）、買賣協議中標題為"其他賣方"的個人（"其他賣方"及與Golden Eagle LP共同為"賣方"）、本公司與Powerfleet Canada Holdings Inc.（"加拿大SPV"及與本公司共同為"買方"）所簽訂，根據該協議，買方取得Golden Eagle Canada Holdings, Inc.（"加拿大持股份公司"）與Complete Innovations Holdings Inc.（"CIH"）的所有直接與間接普通股，以及Golden Eagle Holdings, Inc.的所有已發行與流通普通股（與加拿大持股份公司及CIH共同為"Fleet Complete"）。因此，Fleet Complete成為本公司間接且完全所有的子公司（"FC收購"）。

paragraphs: 以下討論旨在協助您瞭解本公司的財務狀況及營運成果，應與本表單 10-K 其他部分所載的財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。本節中許多金額與百分比為方便呈現而四捨五入，但計算時已使用實際記載的金額。因此，部分資訊可能看起來未計算準確。

本表單 10-K 本節討論本公司於財務年度終結於 2026 年 3 月 31 日及 2025 年 3 月 31 日的財務狀況及營運成果，並依 GAAP 進行 2026 財務年度與 2025 財務年度的年度比較。有關本公司於 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務年度終結及 2025 年 3 月 31 日及 2024 年 3 月 31 日三個月度終結的財務狀況、營運成果、流動性及資本資源，以及未包含於本表單 10-K 的 2025 年 3 月 31 日財務年度與 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，以及 2025 年 3 月 31 日與 2024 年 3 月 31 日三個月度終結的年度比較資訊，請參閱本公司 2025 年 3 月 31 日財務年度終結的年度報告表單 10-K，於第二部分第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之分析」標題下所載內容，該報告已於 2025 年 6 月 26 日向 SEC 提交。

本公司總部設於紐約州伍德克里夫湖，並在全球多處設有辦事處。
我們的 Unity 數據高速公路及 AIoT 生態系統為我們策略的核心。Unity 具備從多個數據來源接收數據的能力，進行數據集的協調與轉換，並透過統一的 SaaS 平台及與客戶業務系統的深度整合，提供簡易易懂的行動見解。
Unity 提供從倉庫至拖車至車輛的關鍵任務解決方案，使客戶能整合供應商，並在單一畫面中取得其營運的端到端控制。
Unity 使客戶能以多種方式使用其數據，從數據驅動的應用程式到統一的營運整合，提供改善資產、資產負責人及業務流程的表現能力，持續提升客戶的業務表現。

在 Unity 生態系統中，我們的 Powerfleet for Warehouse, Yard and Site AIoT 解決方案設計用於提供本地或場內資產的安全性、合規性及操作人員管理、監測與可視化，適用於倉庫及工廠的卡車，例如叉車、人字梯、牽引車及機場的地面支援設備。這些解決方案利用多種通訊功能，例如 Bluetooth®、WiFi 及專用無線電頻率技術，以及 AI 影像解決方案，用於行人接近偵測及事故預防。

此外，在 Unity 生態系統內，我們的 Powerfleet for On-Road AIoT 及 AI 影像解決方案設計用以提供車輛間的 AIoT 資產管理、監測與可視化功能，用於公路運輸的資產如重型卡車、乾貨拖車、冷藏拖車與貨櫃及其相關貨物。這些 AIoT 解決方案提供移動資產追蹤與狀態監測方案，以符合運輸市場對全球供應鏈中更高的可視化、安全、保安與生產力的期望。我們的 On-Road AIoT 解決方案可應用於所有移動資產，無論是租賃車輛、私人車隊或汽車 OEM 委外夥伴。我們透過提供關鍵資訊，用以增加收入、降低費用、提升安全與永續性、達成合規與改善客戶服務。
我們的專利技術已被證明是組織用以監測與分析其資產以提升安全、增加效率、降低費用與提高獲利能力的解決方案。我們的產品與服務以全球品牌 Powerfleet、Pointer、Cellocator、MiX by Powerfleet 及 Fleet Complete 銷售。
自成立以來，我們已產生持續虧損與營運現金流為負，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，累積虧損為 226.3 百萬美元。

我們已採用多種會計政策，用以規範美國通用會計準則在準備我們合併財務報表時的應用。我們認為以下會計政策涉及高度判斷與複雜性，其他重要會計政策於本 10-K 表單所附合併財務報表的附註 2 中說明。某些會計政策涉及我們管理階層的重大判斷與假設，這些判斷與假設可能對某些資產與負債的帳面價值產生重大影響。我們管理階層所使用的判斷與假設是基於歷史經驗及其他因素，並認為在當時情況下是合理的。由於這些判斷與假設的性質，實際結果可能與這些判斷與估計有顯著差異，這可能對我們資產與負債的帳面價值與營運結果產生重大影響。我們認為對我們合併結果有最重大影響的關鍵會計估計、假設與判斷如下說明。

商譽代表取得企業時，所支付金額超過取得企業淨資產公允價值的部分。商譽與被認為具有無限使用年限的無形資產不進行攤銷，並每年進行減值測試，若在年度測試之間發生事件或情況變更，顯示帳面價值可能無法回收，則進行測試。除商譽外的其他無形資產，則按其使用年限進行攤銷，除非使用年限被認為是無限的。無形資產以成本減去累計攤銷後計入帳面價值。無形資產包括商標與商譽、專利、客戶關係及其他無形資產。商譽於報告單位層級進行測試，報告單位定義為營運部門或營運部門下的一層級。我們以一個營運部門運作，該營運部門即為我們合併財務報表中所呈現的唯一報告單位與分部。我們每年於 10 月 1 日進行商譽減值測試，若存在減值跡象則於年度測試之間進行測試，方法為比較報告單位的公允價值與帳面價值。
我們於每年 10 月 1 日於報告單位層級進行商譽減值測試，若存在減值跡象則於年度測試之間進行測試。於 2025 年 10 月 1 日，我們進行了一項量化評估，計算報告單位的公允價值，並以市場法進行。報告單位的公允價值遠高於其帳面價值。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們已產生顯著虧損，並累積了大量虧損。若我們無法實現盈利，本公司普通股的市場價格可能會顯著下跌。
作為一家國際公司，我們面臨總體經濟、地緣政治、貿易、制裁及法規等風險，這些風險可能對我們的業務及財務結果產生重大且不利的影響。
我們的資訊科技系統可能遭受入侵，這可能會損害我們的聲譽、供應商及客戶關係，以及客戶使用我們服務的權利。
我們所處的行業競爭激烈，現有及新興公司的競爭壓力可能對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生重大且不利的影響。
若未能正確且高效地實施企業資源規劃（"ERP"）及客戶關係管理（"CRM"）系統，可能會對我們的業務產生重大且不利的影響。
我們業務的國際性使我們面臨與外匯率、貨幣波動及某些新興市場經濟不穩定相關的風險。
我們可能需要取得額外資金以支應營運，這可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響。
若我們失去一個或數個重要客戶，或這些客戶減少或延後採購，可能會對我們的營業收入產生不利影響。
未能充分保護我們的智慧財產權或對抗第三方主張，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大且不利的影響。
我們的以色列子公司已產生重大負債。
A&R Credit Agreement 的條款限制了 Powerfleet Israel 及 Pointer 現在及未來的營運，特別是他們對應變措施或採取特定行動的能力。
商譽減損或無形資產減損費用可能會在未來影響我們的營運成果。
未能維持有效的內部控制以確保財務報告，可能會對我們的業務及投資者信心產生不利影響。
我們產品的使用受國際法規所規範。

paragraphs: 除本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊外，投資人應謹慎考量下列風險因素，以評估本公司及我們的業務。下列所描述的風險可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，也可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成不利影響。以下為摘要，並非完整列出，投資人應完整閱讀本節「風險因素」。這些及其他風險在本項目 1A「風險因素」中更詳細說明。
我們的業務面臨許多風險與不確定性，包括下列所描述的風險，這些風險包括但不限於：
•我們可能無法完全實現併購及持續業務轉型計畫所預期的效益，而這些整合與業務轉型計畫可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成不利影響，包括我們的財務報導與財務報導內控。
•我們已產生重大虧損，並有相當大的累積虧損。若我們無法實現獲利，本公司普通股的市場價格可能大幅下跌。
•作為一家國際公司，我們面臨總體經濟、地緣政治、貿易、制裁與規範等風險，這些風險可能對我們的業務與財務結果造成重大且不利的影響。
•全球供應鏈中斷、 subcontractors 表現問題，或我們對關鍵零組件供應商的依賴程度過高，可能對我們製造與交付產品的能力造成重大且不利的影響，並可能降低我們的營收與毛利率。
